name: The majority voted against an Australian Greens' motion, which means it failed. ### Motion text > *(1) Clause 2, page 2 (table item 1), omit the table item, substitute:* > >> *A single day to be fixed by Proclamation.* >> >> *1. The whole of this Act* >> >> *A Proclamation must not specify a day that occurs before the day a resolution of the Senate is made that affirms that an Act has commenced which has the effect of establishing a National Integrity Commission.* ### What is the bill's main idea?
